history.none: No earlier conversations for this project.

empty.intro: Ask about your circuit, code or robot. I see the project as it is now, its serial output, safety findings and the last run.
empty.examples: For example: “Why doesn't my robot follow the line?” or “Is my LED wired safely?”

input.label: Your question
input.placeholder: Ask the assistant… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

disclaimer: Answers can be wrong. Suggestions change nothing until you apply them.
filtered: This answer was stopped by the safety filter. Please ask about your robot or circuit.

error.generic: The assistant could not answer. Try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many questions at once. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.contentFiltered: I can't help with that. Ask about robotics, electronics or your project.
error.minor: Your account can use the RoboSim model only.
error.keyMissing: Add a working key for this provider on your Account page first.
error.providerDisabled: This model is not available right now.
error.stream: The answer was cut off. Try again.

proposal.readOnly: This project is read-only, so suggestions cannot be applied.
proposal.applied: Applied. You can undo it like any edit.
proposal.noFile: There is no file {file} any more.

guest.title: Sign in to use the assistant
guest.body: The AI assistant needs an account so it can keep your conversations and credits.

keys.title: AI provider keys
keys.intro: Use your own key with an external AI provider. Keys are tested when saved, stored encrypted and never shown again; only their last four characters appear.
keys.noneEnabled: No external AI providers are enabled on this platform. The RoboSim model is always available.
keys.needsPlan: Your own keys need the Maker plan.
keys.minor: Accounts under 18 use the RoboSim model only.
